question: What is the current LTS version of Node.js? I'm setting up a new service.
answer:
The current **Active LTS** line is **Node.js 24** ("Krypton"), which is the safe default for a new service [1](https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases). Node.js 22 is in maintenance, and Node.js 26 is the newest release line but had only just been promoted to LTS, so some dependencies may lag behind it [1](https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases).

As of 3 November 2026, I'd start on Node 24.

question: I need managed Postgres hosting for a small SaaS, a few GB of data and low traffic. What are the options and what do they cost?
answer:
For a small SaaS, four options cover most needs:

| Host | Entry paid plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Neon | Launch, usage-based, about $19/month typical | Serverless, scales to zero, branching [1](https://neon.com/pricing) |
| Supabase | Pro, $25/month per project | Postgres plus auth and storage; 8 GB database included [2](https://supabase.com/pricing) |
| Render | Basic, from $6/month | Simple fixed-size instances [3](https://render.com/pricing) |
| AWS RDS | db.t4g.micro, about $13/month plus storage | Most control, most setup [4](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/pricing/) |

For low traffic and a few GB, **Neon** is the cheapest to idle and **Supabase** is the best value if you also want auth and storage. Prices are as recorded on the day of this conversation.

question: Help me shortlist 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team. We want pipeline management, email sync and decent reporting.
answer:
Here is a shortlist of five that fit a 20-person sales team:

| CRM | Plan that fits | Price per user per month (annual) |
|---|---|---|
| HubSpot Sales Hub | Professional | $90 [1](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales) |
| Pipedrive | Growth | $39 [2](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing) |
| Salesforce | Pro Suite | $100 [3](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/pricing/) |
| Zoho CRM | Professional | $23 [4](https://www.zoho.com/crm/zohocrm-pricing.html) |
| Close | Growth | $99 [5](https://www.close.com/pricing) |

**Pipedrive** and **Zoho CRM** are the budget picks, **Close** is strongest if the team lives in calls and email, and **HubSpot** or **Salesforce** make sense if marketing will share the system. Prices are as recorded on the day of this conversation.
